description:
Look up one domain, IP address, CIDR block, ASN (AS15169), EVM address (0x…) or Web3 name (ENS .eth, Unstoppable, SPACE ID .bnb, Handshake hns:) and get a compact fact sheet. Domains: registrar, dates, status, nameservers, DNS records, overall mail-security grade, third-party services seen in DNS, possibly dangling records. IPs, CIDRs and ASNs: network owner, origin AS, RIR, cloud / CDN provider, Tor or iCloud Private Relay tag, geolocation, abuse contact, local reputation. Web3 names: registration status, addresses, records, ENS expiry. A 0x EVM address: its ENS primary name on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, Linea and Scroll (reverse lookup). A look-alike warning is added when the name uses deceptive letters.

Use it first for any question about who owns, runs, hosts or registered something. Prefer check_mail_security when you need each email check rather than the grade, and check_lookalike to screen many names without network calls.

Behavior: queries registries, DNS and (for Web3) blockchain RPC live, usually in 1-5 s, at most about 12 s. If one source fails, the rest is still returned and the failure is listed under errors. Reputation covers local blocklists only: no match is not a clean bill of health. Queries are not logged or stored. The result ends with details_url, the full page with every record and its provenance.

namespace.description: optional; force a Web3 namespace (ens, unstoppable, spaceid, sns or hns) when a name could belong to several, e.g. a TLD that is both an ICANN TLD and a Web3 namespace. Leave empty and the namespace is detected from the name

query.description: what to look up: a domain (example.com, münchen.de), IPv4 / IPv6 address, CIDR (8.8.8.0/24), ASN written as AS15169 (a bare number is not an ASN), a Web3 name (vitalik.eth, brad.crypto, spaceid.bnb, bonfida.sns, hns:name), or an EVM address (0xd8dA…6045) to find its ENS primary names

name: lookup_target

announced_prefix.description: prefix announced in BGP (RIPE RIS) that covers an IP or CIDR; absent when RIS data is off

announced_prefix_count.description: for an ASN: number of prefixes it originates (RIPE RIS)

availability.description: registered, available or unknown (domains and Web3 names)

dnssec.description: DNSSEC status from the resolver: secure (resolver-validated), signed (DS present, not validated), keys (DNSKEY only) or insecure

errors.description: provider failures; the rest of the result is still valid

grace_ends_at.description: end of the renewal grace period (.eth names); expires_at holds the registration expiry

internet_exchange.description: for an address inside an internet exchange peering LAN: the exchange

irr.description: routing registry (IRR) check of the announcement of an IP or CIDR: match, less_specific, mismatch or none; absent without IRR data. A registry object is a claim, not an authorisation

network_type.description: PeeringDB network type of the AS (NSP, Content, Cable/DSL/ISP, ...), self-reported; absent when PeeringDB data is off

origin_as.description: origin AS number for an IP

peering_policy.description: PeeringDB general peering policy (Open, Selective, Restrictive, No)

primary_names.description: for a 0x address: ENS primary names as network:name (ethereum, base, optimism, arbitrum, linea, scroll)

reputation.description: verdict from local lists; absent when no list is loaded

rpki.description: route origin validation of the announcement of an IP or CIDR: valid, invalid or not_found; absent without RIS and VRP data. Informational

summary.description: the full human-readable fact sheet, the same text as the text content

type.description: target type: domain, ipv4, ipv6, cidr, asn or web3_name

title: WHOIS / RDAP / DNS / network / Web3 lookup
